snippet.title: Best Guess Live | Official Game Announcement | Netflix
snippet.description:
Compete for a chance to win real money in this live mobile game every weekday. Use your smarts and five clever clues to submit the right answer first.

Participation open to legal residents of the 50 United States and D.C., 18+. Void where prohibited. Access to a Netflix account and a PayPal account required for participation and prize fulfillment. “Best Guess Live” is a skill-based game. Official Terms & Conditions at https://bit.ly/BestGuessLive. Sponsor: Three J Productions, Inc.

Subscribe: https://bit.ly/3Rw25E1

About Netflix Games: 
Netflix Games is part of your Netflix membership. No ads, no extra fees, no in-app purchases. Just unlimited access to exclusive mobile games you can play anytime, anywhere. With over 300 million members in 190+ countries, Netflix is bringing stories to life across TV, film, and games. Now you can play them, too.
